intro h
split
· intro s a hsa
  have := h (s ∪ {a}) (insert_mem _ _ hsa)
  rw [Finset.insert_union, Finset.union_insert] at this
  exact this
· intros s t hst
  cases Finset.eq_or_lt s t with h1 h2
  · exact le_rfl
  · rcases hst with ⟨a, h1, h2⟩
    have := h s a h1
    exact this
